summary.text: Chris Gilmer-Hill is the Democratic candidate for the Michigan House of Representatives, District 8, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a lifelong Detroiter, democratic socialist, environmental justice advocate and union member.

paragraphs.text: Chris Gilmer-Hill graduated from Detroit Country Day High School and attended Harvard University for both his bachelor's and graduate degrees, and Ballotpedia lists his profession as policy analyst.
Gilmer-Hill said in the survey that he is not taking corporate PAC money.

He listed three campaign messages: affordability, including stronger accountability for DTE, tenant protections and legislation for a single-payer healthcare system; investing in communities rather than corporations; and making government work for residents.
He said getting corporate money out of politics is among the policy areas he cares about most.

sources.title: Chris Gilmer-Hill, Ballotpedia Candidate Connection survey (2026)
